subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Escrever, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, slogans, anúncios publicitários e textos de campanhas de conscientização destinados ao público infantil, dentre outros gêneros do campo publicitário, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/ assunto/finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Escrever colaborativamente um slogan adequado à situação comunicativa e propósito
components.description_en: Write collaboratively a slogan suited to its communicative situation and purpose
components.cc_component_description: Choose language style and tone appropriate to a specific audience and purpose

components.description_pt: Escrever colaborativamente um anúncio direcionado a público infantil considerando tema e propósito
components.description_en: Write collaboratively an advertisement aimed at a young audience considering topic and purpose
components.cc_component_description: Plan writing by considering purpose, audience, and the most significant ideas to convey

components.description_pt: Escrever colaborativamente um texto de campanha de conscientização para público infantil
components.description_en: Write collaboratively an awareness-campaign text aimed at a young audience considering genre conventions
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

cc_matches.description: Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.
Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.

With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
